messages:
Priya Rao: FYI we received an AWS marketplace invoice with one line using an unknown subscription id; buyer_account_id blank so it didn't join to any reseller. amount looks material (~$7k).
Alex Kim: can you drop the invoice line here?
Priya Rao: pasted CSV snippet from the billing export below. product_code, subscription_id, usage_amount, buyer_account_id -> buyer field is empty.
```
product_code,subscription_id,usage_amount,buyer_account_id
ML-INFERENCE-STD,sub-0b7d12,7123,
```
Jules Martin: blank buyer id = orphaned usage. sometimes marketplace sends subscription before finalization. did we try matching on purchase_email or order_number?
Priya Rao: ingestion logs show no purchase_email for sub-0b7d12. error: `marketplace_ingest WARN missing_buyer_meta sub-0b7d12` at 2026-03-19T02:03:11Z
Ben (finance): clarify: invoice line is $7,123 gross? what's our net after channel percentages?
Priya Rao: yes gross $7,123. net to us would be $4,300 after standard channel splits. AWS charged us full amount.
Alex Kim: have we hit this before? previous orphan case got resolved by AWS support after they matched purchase metadata; took ~10 business days.
Jules Martin: next steps: 1) open AWS partner support case requesting they attach buyer_account_id or reissue corrected invoice; 2) finance holds payment to reseller until allocation confirmed; 3) engineering adds alerting for orphan subs in ingestion.
Priya Rao: I've opened case #987654321. Submitted ingestion payloads and raw invoice. link: https://aws.amazon.com/support/cases/987654321
invoicing-bot: Automated: invoice 2026-03-18 AWM-9987 queued for reconciliation.
Ben (finance): instruction: do NOT remit reseller share for that line until AWS confirms mapping. Holding >$5k requires VP signoff; flagging CFO.
Alex Kim: what's the GL treatment in the meantime? suspense account or accrue?
Ben (finance): post to suspense liability GL 2205 pending allocation; we'll reverse when resolved. I'll book a memo.
Jules Martin: we may need to issue a manual credit to the reseller if AWS refuses to reclassify. Can finance authorize up to $5k in manual credits without VP signoff?
Ben (finance): authorized up to $5k. Anything above requires VP Finance approval. This line exceeds $5k so escalate when AWS response arrives.
Priya Rao: action items recorded: Priya monitor/support case and escalate in 48h (owner: Priya), Ben hold payment + post suspense GL (owner: Ben), Jules create JIRA to capture missing buyer metadata and add retention of raw marketplace payloads (owner: Jules), Alex notify eng-ops to implement alert `marketplace.orphan_sub` (owner: Alex). Target resolution: 2 weeks.
Alex Kim: suggested alert snippet for eng-ops:
```
if not record.buyer_account_id:
  emit_alert('marketplace.orphan_sub', subscription_id=record.subscription_id)
```
Priya Rao: i'll update here when AWS responds. escalate to partner support lead if no reply in 48h. :thumbsup:
Ben (finance): acknowledged; i'll loop in VP Finance if AWS cannot confirm mapping.
Jules Martin: tracking in JIRA; pinging again tomorrow.
Priya Rao: thanks everyone."
